chunks: And those who say: 'O our Lord, avert from us the torment of Hell; indeed, its torment is continuous.'
ai.seo_question: What do believers say to ask God to avert the torment of Hell?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the supplication of the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that 'gharam' (costly burden) refers to the perpetual, exhausting nature of Hellfire's torment. It serves as a theological anchor for the concept of intercession (Shafa'ah), where believers seek deliverance not merely by escaping punishment, but by attaining the status of those who are saved from its grip through divine mercy.
